comment: PLAN-127 night-shift A/B strategy A2 — COMPREHENSIVE spec. Expresses the ENTIRE op chain of oracle scripts/build-panel-frame5-assets.py (R-357 frame set v5, sliced directly from the baptized golden mockup-r357-cornici-aperta.png, case a of PLAN-127 §3.2). Every field prefixed x- is a CANDIDATE schema field the engine does not yet implement: declared here so the spec is self-documenting and each gap is named, not implicit. EXPECTED to fail jsonschema validation on the x- keys — see panel-frame5-full-runnable.json for the engine-supported subset and test-results/slicekit/night-shift/frame5-full-findings.md for the gap analysis.

x-oracle.comment: Two oracle functions: edge() = opaque RGB strip + 30px wrap crossfade (alpha 255 everywhere); keyart() = colour-class key + despeckle + 3px border soften on all sides.
x-oracle.sourceNotes: The golden is a full painted mockup (map + panels), NOT a flat-background render — flatBgMaxDiff cannot express the oracle's key, which selects by colour CLASS (brass/gem) wherever they sit in the image. No global key: keying is per-slice, so each slice carries its own x-key. No cutouts: the oracle punches no interior hole — keying drops the plaque/map background for keyart pieces and edges are opaque crops of painted border.

x-pipeline: crop (+wrapBlend overlap extension on the repeat axis, edges only)
key (per-slice: colorClassDelta on corner|ornament, none on edges) — engine has only a single global source.key of type flatBgMaxDiff
despeckle (corner|ornament) — oracle neighbour filter, no engine equivalent
borderSoften (corner|ornament) — oracle 3px floor ramp on all sides; closest engine op is tailFade but it zeroes the rim pixel and is meant for corner→edge transitions only
WebP RGBA save (quality 92, alpha lossless) — engine parity

geometry.comment: INFERRED from the oracle docstring (roster panel box x14-340, y108-453; left spine x15-49; right wire x331-338; bottom wire y449-453) — corner crops span the painted knuckles outside the panel box (frame rides OUTSIDE, ~1px inner-rim overlap, Director ruling). emblem-chest belongs to the stash's top band below (y458-504), not this rect. Per-surface visual fork confirms.

x-key.comment: oracle keyart(): keep = max(brass, gem+bias); alpha = clip((keep - threshold) * gain, 0, 255). Per-class keying: keeps warm acanthus metal + emerald knuckles, drops teal/blue/grey map+plaque.

x-despeckle.comment: oracle keyart(): an opaque px needs >=3 opaque 8-neighbours to survive — kills lone map-foliage specks that key as green

x-borderSoften.comment: oracle keyart(): alpha *= (i+1)/(widthPx+1) at offset i in [0,widthPx) — floor 0.25 at the rim px, never zeroes it (unlike tailFade which ramps to 0 at the edge)
